stages: Stage 1: Download & parse paper (arxiv API + PDF extract)
Stage 2: Generate code skeleton (LLM, based on paper content)
Stage 3: Extract testable assertions (IO examples, numerical claims, properties)
Stage 5: Run benchmark — PASS → encode CapsuleGene to Gene Pool; FAIL → record for GapAnalyzer feedback
